significant_terms: Renfra shall set up 2 (Two) Wind Turbine Generators (WTGs) of 3.3 MW each aggregating to 6.6 MW in Karur District, Tamil Nadu on a turnkey basis.
execution_period_raw: Commissioning on or before November 30, 2026, subject to acquisition of a portion of land parcels and receipt of approvals from regulatory authorities.
consideration_raw: The consideration agreed under the EPC Contract is ~Rs. 62.00 Crores (inclusive of GST).
labeller_notes: Company is the awarder, not the recipient: its material subsidiary Beta Wind Farm Private Limited executed an EPC contract with Renfra Energy India Limited (domestic) on 17 Sep 2026. receipt_datetime is the contract execution date. Follow-up to LOI intimation dated 20 May 2026. Commissioning is a deadline, so execution_months left null.
